patches.why: Default-settings generator (0x140d8af60): 'if dedicated VRAM >= 8000 MB skip caps' becomes an unconditional skip, so 6-8 GB cards no longer get texture quality forced to Medium and <6 GB cards to Low.
Same function: 'if system RAM >= 16 GB keep preset' becomes unconditional, so 8-12 GB systems are not dropped to quality preset 1.

evidence: 0x140d8af60 is called only when settings defaults are generated (0x14012b795 when the settings 'needs defaults' flag bit 24 of +0x79d0 is set, then cleared; 0x140140177 = reset to defaults; 0x140c8e22e = settings-menu budget preview). Thresholds: movabs 0x1f4000000 (8000 MiB), 0x177000000 (6000 MiB), 0x400000000 (16 GiB) read from the instructions.
risk: Only affects freshly generated defaults and the menu preview. Players on low-VRAM cards get High texture defaults and may need to lower them by hand.
